actions.description: Inspect existing SQLite schema and jobs
actions.command: if [ -f /var/lib/job-queue/jobs.sqlite3 ]; then sqlite3 /var/lib/job-queue/jobs.sqlite3 '.schema' && printf '\n-- rows --\n' && sqlite3 -header -column /var/lib/job-queue/jobs.sqlite3 'SELECT * FROM jobs ORDER BY rowid;'; else echo 'database missing'; fi

actions.description: Inspect deployed files and service users
actions.command: find /opt/job-queue /etc/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname '*queue*' -o -path '/opt/job-queue/*' 2>/dev/null | sort; printf '\n-- users --\n'; id; getent passwd queue queue-api queue-worker 2>/dev/null || true

actions.description: Inspect database durability settings and permissions
actions.command: stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /var/lib/job-queue /var/lib/job-queue/jobs.sqlite3; sqlite3 /var/lib/job-queue/jobs.sqlite3 'PRAGMA journal_mode; PRAGMA synchronous; PRAGMA user_version;'

actions.description: Set executable permissions and compile queue programs
Check service enablement and seed state
actions.command: systemctl is-enabled queue-api.service queue-worker.service queue-seed.service 2>&1 || true; systemctl is-active queue-seed.service 2>&1 || true

actions.description: Reload units and start API and worker
actions.command: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl reset-failed queue-api.service queue-worker.service && systemctl restart queue-api.service queue-worker.service && sleep 1 && systemctl --no-pager --full status queue-api.service queue-worker.service
